card.name: Just before Q or C-abbreviations in trials
card.fires_on: Fires on a short piece just before a Q-like or C-initial name is completed, such as the C of Cogstate, the dash in C-SSRS, the 5 in QTc 500, or -Q in long-QT. It also fires on the 5 in cutoffs such as CrCl 50.

modes.label: Cutoff numbers
modes.description: The digit 5 or the decimal point in a threshold, such as a QTc or CrCl cutoff.

modes.label: Test or scale names
modes.description: A piece of a cognitive or rating scale name, such as Cogstate or C-SSRS, or the hyphen in it.

card.writes: It lowers the chance that a Q or Quality word comes next, and mildly promotes odd word pieces.
card.plain: It fires partway through a scale name or cutoff number, such as C-SSRS or QTc 500, where the next piece is not a Q word.
